name: Falklands War: land campaign (San Carlos to Stanley)

sides.name: United Kingdom (3 Commando Brigade, 5 Infantry Brigade, Task Force)
sides.note: Strength: 4,000 men of 3 Commando Brigade landed at San Carlos on 21 May (40, 42, 45 Cdo; 2 and 3 Para), 5 Infantry Brigade (2 Scots Guards, 1 Welsh Guards, 1/7 Gurkha Rifles) added ~5,000 by 1 June (Wikipedia); infantry_line counts rifle strength, educated (~600-700 per battalion plus SAS/SBS). Armour: 4 Scorpion + 4 Scimitar (Blues and Royals). Artillery: 29 Cdo Regt three batteries + 29 Bty 4 Fd Regt, 105 mm Light Guns in 6-gun batteries: 18 + 12 = 30 (DTIC ADA401278); low = guns ashore in the first days. Air: 28 Sea Harrier FRS1 (fighter), ~10-14 Harrier GR3 (strike); helicopters ~100 (Sea King, Wessex, Gazelle, Scout, one Chinook), educated. Naval: 2 carriers, 2 LPDs, ~23 destroyers/frigates; 5 SSN + 1 SSK, educated from the Task Force list. Tech (derived:tech-anchor, 1982 near 1985 anchor 9): weapons 8.8 (Milan, AIM-9L, Rapier, Sea Dart); armor 8.4 (only light CVR(T)); comms 8.8 (SCOT satcom). Ratings: training 0.95 = elite long-service professionals (Paras, Royal Marines, Guards, Gurkhas); command 0.8; morale 0.8.

sides.name: Argentina (Malvinas garrison and air forces)
sides.note: Strength: ~13,000 land forces at peak on the islands (Wikipedia infobox), incl. air force and support personnel; infantry_line = ~8-10 army infantry regiments plus BIM 5 marines, educated. ifv_apc = 12 Panhard AML-90 armoured cars. Artillery: ~30 OTO Melara 105 mm pack howitzers (1.5 battalions, British estimate in DTIC ADA401278) plus a few 155 mm. Aircraft were mainland-based at the edge of their radius: Mirage III/Dagger as fighters; A-4 Skyhawk, Super Etendard, Canberra, Pucara (on the islands), MB-339 as strike; counts educated. Fleet stayed in port after the Belgrano sinking (2 May), so no ships are listed. Starts: Stanley and its mountain ring (Longdon, Two Sisters, Tumbledown, Wireless Ridge), outer Mount Kent area, Goose Green/Darwin, Port Howard and Fox Bay on West Falkland. Tech: logistics 7.5 (air bridge, then blockade; troops underfed). Ratings: command 0.35 (Menendez static, poor army/air coordination); morale 0.4 (cold, hungry conscripts; BIM 5 an exception); training 0.4 (1963-class conscripts with months of service). Fortified: prepared positions on the high ground.

outcome.note: 21 May (San Carlos) to 14 June 1982 (surrender at Stanley). Argentina: 11,313 captured over the war (Wikipedia), of whom the vast majority on the islands, plus land-campaign killed (~250-300 of the 649 total; 323 died on the Belgrano) and ~1,000 wounded, educated split. UK: war total 255 killed, 775 wounded, 115 captured; land-campaign share incl. Sir Galahad (48 killed, 115 wounded) but excluding ship losses at sea is an educated range. Goose Green alone: 961 Argentines captured. Grade C on losses.
